blocks.text: Stream Deck Mini features six customizable LCD keys that let you instantly trigger unlimited actions in popular apps like OBS Studio, XSplit, Streamlabs, Twitch, YouTube and many more — the list keeps growing and the possibilities are endless thanks to Stream Deck SDK. System Requirements macOS 10.15 or newer Windows 10 (64-bit)
